tool_names_trajectory.description: Tool-call NAMES only, in order -- see argus/eval/custom_metrics.py for why ADK's builtin tool_trajectory_avg_score (which also compares args for exact equality) doesn't fit this project's free-text AgentTool arguments.

numeric_fidelity.description: Re-runs the quant computation independently from the raw mock data (spec EV1: re-run the code, assert equal) and checks the response's claimed numbers against it.

independent_groundedness.description: Re-derives groundedness from scratch using claim_matcher.py's compute_grounding against the real mock data -- deliberately not trusting the run's own meta.groundedness, which is the system under test grading itself.

contradiction_correctness.description: Checks the response's contradiction-disclosure behavior against reconciler.py's ground truth for the scenario's company -- did it flag a real contradiction, and stay silent when there wasn't one?
